**Checklist:**
- [ ] Sign and deliver this Agreement with all the schedules along with the payments due as stipulated in the Payment Plan within thirty days from the date of receipt by the Allottee [D39]
- [ ] Appear for registration of the Agreement before the concerned Sub-Registrar as and when intimated by the Promoter [D39]
- [ ] Pay the remaining price of the [Apartment/Plot] as prescribed in the Payment Plan as may be demanded by the Promoter within the time and in the manner specified therein [D17]
- [ ] Make all payments, on demand by the Promoter, within the stipulated time as mentioned in the Payment Plan through A/c Payee cheque/demand draft or online payment (as applicable) in favour of ‘_______________’ payable at___________. [D17]
- [ ] Take possession of the Apartment/Plot from the Promoter by executing necessary indemnities, undertakings and such other documentation as prescribed in this Agreement, upon receiving a written intimation from the Promoter as per clause 7.2 [D24]
- [ ] Pay maintenance charges as determined by the Promoter/association of allottees, as the case may be [D24]
- [ ] Pay the total maintenance charges, as determined and thereafter, billed by the maintenance agency appointed or the association of allottees (or the maintenance agency appointed by it) and performance by the Allottee of all his/her obligations in respect of the terms and conditions specified by the maintenance agency or the association of allottees from time to time [D36]
- [ ] Maintain the Apartment/Plot at his/her own cost, in good repair and condition after taking possession [D38]
- [ ] Not put any sign-board / name-plate, neon light, publicity material or advertisement material etc. on the face / facade of the building or anywhere on the exterior of the project, buildings therein or common areas [D38]

**Key dates and amounts:**
- Within ninety days from the date of termination of allotment, the Promoter shall refund to the Allottee the entire amount received by the Promoter from the allotment [D22]
- Within ninety days of such cancellation, the balance amount of money paid by the allottee shall be returned by the promoter to the allottee [D25]
- Within ninety days from the date of termination of allotment, the Promoter shall refund to the Allottee the entire money paid by the Allottee under any head whatsoever towards the purchase of the apartment/plot, along with interest at the rate specified in the Rules [D32]
- Within ninety days from the date of such cancellation, the balance amount of money paid by the allottee shall be returned by the promoter to the allottee [D25]
- Within three months from the issuance of the occupancy certificate*, the Promoter shall execute a conveyance deed and convey the title of the Apartment/Plot together with proportionate indivisible share in the Common Areas [D34]
- Within three months from the date of issue of such notice, the Promoter shall offer in writing the possession of the Apartment/Plot, to the Allottee [D23]
- Within thirty days from the date of its receipt by the Allottee, the Allottee shall sign and deliver this Agreement [D39]

**Documents to keep:**
- The Agreement for Sale [D1]
- The payment plan set out in Schedule C (“Payment Plan”) [D12]
- The occupancy certificate* or the completion certificate or both [D20]
- The necessary indemnities, undertakings and such other documentation as prescribed in this Agreement [D24]
- The conveyance deed [D34]
- The notice from the Promoter offering possession of the Apartment/Plot [D23]
